description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Good chance of finding a join or other fragments in the hand of the same scribe. Mentions Barakāt Ibn al-Ḥazzan. Gives at least one date according to the Coptic calendar (Sunday, 22 Baʿūna). Mentions ʿAzzāz; silk; the 9th of Rabīʿ I; cotton; some sort of silken upper garment (fawqāniyya); R. Kalev; David al-Rūmī; robes.
